label: UI Mock: Video Player Device
description: The video-in-video device: a dark player window whose scrub bar ADVANCES in real time, clock counting, scene badge ticking (scene 2/6...). Frames any content (image with Ken Burns, or a brand field) as 'a video the product just made'. THE beat for deliverable-is-a-video stories: the agent hands back a finished film and you watch it playing.

title.label: Filename in the title bar, e.g. 'campaign-video.mp4'

image_url.label: Image shown inside the player (Ken Burns drift); omit for a soft brand field

runtime_seconds.label: The fake video's total runtime for the clock (default 32)

scene_count.label: If set (>1), badge ticks 'scene N / M' as playback advances
